UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User session profile, country preferences, online status, and age verification for JIMMY random video chat.

countryCode.description: ISO country code of the user (e.g. MM, TH, JP, KR, US).

countryName.description: Human-readable country name of the user.

targetCountryCode.description: Selected destination country code (ALL or specific ISO code).

ageVerified.description: Whether the user has confirmed they are 18+ years old.

CallRoom.title: CallRoom
CallRoom.description: Matchmaking room and WebRTC / live video telemetry session between two strangers.

hostId.description: UID of the user who created the waiting call room.

hostCountryCode.description: ISO country code of the host.

targetCountryCode.description: Preferred country filter set by the host (ALL or ISO code).

guestId.description: UID of the matched stranger (empty string when waiting).

guestName.description: Display name of the matched guest.

guestCountryCode.description: ISO country code of the matched guest.

guestCountryName.description: Country name of the matched guest.

rtcOfferSdp.description: WebRTC SDP offer / media signaling payload from host.

rtcAnswerSdp.description: WebRTC SDP answer / media signaling payload from guest.

hostFrameData.description: Compressed real-time video frame / telemetry from host camera.

guestFrameData.description: Compressed real-time video frame / telemetry from guest camera.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when room was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Real-time text message exchanged inside an active video call room.

roomId.description: ID of the parent call room.

senderId.description: UID of the sender matching request.auth.uid.

participants.description: Bounded 2-element array of participant UIDs in the call room for query isolation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ModerationAction.title: ModerationAction
ModerationAction.description: Safety report or user block created by an authenticated user.

targetUserId.description: UID of the reported or blocked stranger.

targetCountryCode.description: Country code of the reported or blocked stranger.

actionType.description: Whether this action is a report or a block.

roomId.description: Call room ID where the incident occurred.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the moderation action (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user session profile, country settings, and online status.

/call_rooms/{roomId}.description: Matchmaking queue and active WebRTC / live video call rooms.

/call_rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId.description: In-call real-time text chat messages scoped to room participants.

/users/{userId}/moderation_actions/{acti.description: Safety reports and blocked user records owned by the user.
